lede: ChatGPT Ads goes full performance channel as OpenAI ships carousels, oCPC and conversion tracking — while luxury's own Brunello Cucinelli and Kering signal two very different AI bets on commerce and brand recovery.

stories.headline: ChatGPT Ads Rolls Out oCPC Bidding, Multi-Product Carousels and Automatic Advanced Matching — A New Performance Tier Opens for Luxury E-Commerce
stories.summary: OpenAI shipped its most significant ChatGPT Ads product batch yet this week: conversion-optimised CPC campaigns in beta for product feed advertisers, a live multi-product carousel format allowing multiple SKUs per ad unit, dynamic URL parameters for clean attribution, and automatic advanced matching rolling out to all existing web pixels by 17 August. New third-party integrations with Triple Whale and Hightouch close the attribution loop luxury performance teams have been waiting for. ChatGPT Ads is no longer an awareness experiment — it is now a measurable, optimisation-capable channel that belongs on the luxury media plan.

stories.headline: Salesforce Backs Brunello Cucinelli's AI Commerce Platform Callimacus — The 'Pageless' Storefront Goes Enterprise
stories.summary: Salesforce has taken a strategic stake in Callimacus, the agentic AI platform built by Brunello Cucinelli's Solomei AI research centre, to accelerate its deployment across Europe and North America. Callimacus replaces traditional website navigation with an orchestra of AI agents that composes a personalised, pageless digital experience for each visitor in real time — early results from Cucinelli's own site showed doubled time-on-site and higher conversion rates, prompting interest from 40+ consumer-goods companies outside luxury. The deal, backed by Cucinelli, Salesforce's Marc Benioff and the Cucinelli family holding company, is the clearest proof yet that luxury's AI commerce experiments are ready for enterprise scale.

stories.headline: Kering Returns to Comparable Growth in Q2 After 12 Consecutive Quarters of Decline — AI-Enabled Operations Are Central to the Recovery Plan
stories.summary: Kering posted Q2 2026 revenue of €3.65 billion, up 2% comparable — snapping a streak of 12 consecutive quarterly declines — as Gucci retail improved seven points sequentially and jewellery surged 18%. CEO Luca de Meo confirmed that 'a deeper push into AI-enabled operations' is a core pillar of the Rinascimento transformation plan, alongside a group-wide shared platform designed to help houses move faster on data, inventory and clienteling. With 84 net store closures in H1 and margins improving to 12.8%, Kering is rebuilding on a leaner, technology-reinforced base.

stories.headline: Google's Generative AI Performance Reports in Search Console Are Rolling Out Globally — Luxury Brands Can Now Measure AI Overview Impressions for the First Time
stories.summary: Google's dedicated Generative AI performance reports — launched in June and now in phased global rollout — give site owners their first isolated view of impressions inside AI Overviews, AI Mode and generative Discover features, completely separate from standard organic data. For luxury brands whose editorial content and product pages are routinely surfaced in AI-generated summaries, this is the first time citation volume can be tracked as a standalone KPI, independent of click-through rates that AI surfaces do not yet report. The strategic implication is immediate: brand authority in AI search is now measurable, and optimising for it is no longer guesswork.

stories.headline: Salesforce Expands Agentforce with AI Shopping Agents — Luxury Retailers Using Salesforce Commerce Cloud Are Next in Line
stories.summary: Salesforce expanded its Agentforce platform on 23 July with dedicated AI shopping agents capable of handling end-to-end purchase journeys — product discovery, comparison, cart management and post-purchase service — with no human in the loop. With 78 of North America's Top 2000 online retailers running on Salesforce, and the Callimacus partnership already demonstrating luxury appetite for agentic commerce, the upgrade puts autonomous AI clienteling within direct reach of fashion and accessories brands on the platform. For luxury houses weighing the shift from advisor-led to agent-mediated discovery, this marks the moment the infrastructure caught up with the ambition.
